summary: This resolution censures Representative Ilhan Omar for statements she made after Charlie Kirk's assassination and removes her from the House Education and Workforce and Budget committees.

scores.thoughts: The resolution censures a Representative and removes her from the Budget Committee. This is a personnel and disciplinary action with no provisions altering government spending levels, appropriations, or fiscal policy.
The bill contains no tax-related provisions, rate changes, or revenue measures of any kind.
No healthcare policy, coverage, or regulatory changes are addressed in the resolution.
The resolution makes no reference to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration, border, or visa provisions appear in the text.
The resolution does not engage with reproductive rights or abortion policy.
No military, defense, or national security spending or policy changes are present.
The bill contains no environmental, climate, or regulatory provisions.
No welfare, entitlement, or social program provisions are included.

The resolution removes the member from the Education and Workforce Committee, but this is solely a committee assignment matter and does not alter education policy, funding, or federal involvement in schools.
No drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related policy language exists.
While the resolution references an assassination, it does not modify criminal statutes, sentencing, or policing policy.
The bill has no trade, tariff, or globalization provisions.
Removal from the Budget Committee is noted, but the resolution does not change debt policy, deficit targets, or fiscal rules.
The resolution quotes statements from a video mentioning transgender issues, but it takes no legislative position on LGBTQ rights or protections.
No foreign aid, international assistance, or related funding provisions are present.
The bill does not address voting access, election integrity, or electoral procedures.
No technology regulation, data privacy, or platform oversight measures are included.
The resolution contains no labor, union, or workplace policy provisions.
The resolution quotes language referencing a 'Christofascist agenda' from the video, but it does not enact or alter any religious liberty or anti-discrimination policy.
